About Lavenders (LAVNDR120)

Last updated: 1 November 2026

What is Lavenders?

The core: revealing consumer behaviour. Lavenders reveals consumer behaviour: what people actually order, when, and from which businesses, drawn from the real orders of 120 businesses and brands, turned into a live index (LAVNDR120) and reports for businesses and brands.

Lavenders (Arabic: لاڤندرز) is a digital market system that brings together 120 businesses and brands in a single market. Each business runs its own order-management app (OMS), and their real orders feed one live consumer index called LAVNDR120, updated moment by moment. Every business in the market can see the performance of the other 119.

The name is a brand for a market system and has no connection to lavender plants or lavender oil.

How the index moves

  1. 120 businesses: each has its own order app.
  2. Every new order raises its business's weight inside the index.
  3. More orders mean a higher index value.

What the home page shows

The home page shows the real “Order value” card to every visitor: the current value, the daily change, the day's high and low, and volatility. Other screens are demo data for visitors and real data for subscribers.

Terms

  • Lavenders — the system and brand name.
  • LAVNDR120 — its live consumer index.
  • OMS — the order-management system for businesses and brands, on web and Android.
  • Lava — the market data itself, read-only.
  • Vindex — the Oracle forecasting report, limited to 120 members.
  • Magma — a limited (500-member) membership to explore the market.

Two paths

Join Up is for following the market: Lava, Vindex and Magma. Join the Economic Movement is for taking part in building it: OMS, Reseller, Franchise and Tycoon. See all seven packages.

What is a consumer index? How LAVNDR120 works

Last updated: 1 November 2026

The short answer

A consumer index is a single number that summarises consumption activity across a group of goods or organisations and is updated regularly, so you can see whether consumption is rising or falling.

LAVNDR120 is the consumer index of the Lavenders system: it measures the real order activity of 120 businesses and brands in one market, updated moment by moment, and is used to reveal consumer behaviour: what people actually order and from which businesses.

What makes LAVNDR120 different

  • It moves with real orders that each business records in its own order system (OMS).
  • It covers 120 businesses and brands in one market, not a single business.
  • It is shown to everyone on the home page in the “Order value” card.

How the index moves

  1. 120 businesses: each has its own order app.
  2. Every new order raises its business's weight inside the index.
  3. More orders mean a higher index value.

What the card shows

  • Current value of the index in US dollars.
  • Change: the difference from the previous value, in amount and percent.
  • High: the highest value the index reached today.
  • Low: the lowest value it fell to today.
  • Volatility: how much the index moved during the day; the higher it is, the more movement.

How to read it

A rising index means more real orders in the market; a falling index means fewer. The index shows direction; it does not explain the cause on its own.

What it is not

  • Not a stock and not a trading price: there is no buying, selling or trading of shares on the platform.
  • Not a promise of profit or returns. This content is informational, not investment advice.
  • Not related to lavender plants. The name is a brand for a market system.

The golden certificate for businesses in Lavenders

Last updated: 15 November 2026

What it is

The core: revealing consumer behaviour. Lavenders reveals consumer behaviour: what people actually order, when, and from which businesses, drawn from the real orders of 120 businesses and brands, turned into a live index (LAVNDR120) and reports for businesses and brands.

The golden certificate is the optional operating-fund right of a business that feeds the index with real orders. It is based on the business's own documented orders.

How it works

  1. Reach 100 documented orders through your Lavenders order app. Each order must be documented by a tax invoice from the approved ledger.
  2. Request the certificate from your business page (optional).
  3. Casting value: the business pays 36% of the total of its approved orders in cash; each order is valued at $4.275.
  4. Review and verification: the administration reviews the request, and the value is shown after the three verification conditions are met.

Donating a certificate

A business can donate part or all of its certificate value to another business. Each side enters a phone number and a contact method, and the details are revealed to both only when the donation is accepted.

What it is not

  • Not buying, selling or trading of shares: there is none on the platform.
  • Not investment advice and not a promise of profit or returns.
  • The terms and agreements are drafts pending legal review.

Start with an order app

To generate documented orders you need your own order system. The app builder creates one for you, and the OMS package covers it.

Frequently asked questions

What is the golden certificate?

An optional certificate that a business in Lavenders may request from the index operating fund. Its founding value is based on the documented orders of the business, with each order valued at $4.275.

Who can request it?

A business that has reached 100 documented orders. Orders count only when documented by a tax invoice from the approved ledger. Requesting a certificate is optional.

What does the business pay?

To mint the certificate, the business pays 36% of the total of its approved orders in cash. That payment is the casting value of its golden certificate.

How is a request reviewed?

The Lavenders administration reviews the request. If it is accepted, the certificate value is shown once three verification conditions are met: financial, guarantee and documentary.

Can a certificate be donated to another business?

Yes. A business may donate part or all of its certificate value to another business. Contact details are exchanged between the two sides only when the offer is accepted.

Is this investment advice or a promise of returns?

No. The information is descriptive only. There is no buying, selling or trading of shares on the platform, no promise of profit or returns, and the terms and agreements are drafts pending legal review.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 25 October 2026 · Applies to the website lavndrs120.github.io and the LAVNDR120 Android app

1. Who we are

LAVNDR120 is a consumer-index platform covering 120 businesses and brands. Subscribers follow the index and members join its paths. It is run by the platform owner (Oms). For any question about your data, see "Contact" below.

2. Data we collect

  • Google account: when you sign in, we receive only your email address and name from Google, to verify your identity. We do not receive your password and cannot access your mail or files.
  • Subscription and membership data: the package you choose, your country or region where needed, subscription status and dates, and the bank-transfer number or reference you enter to confirm payment.
  • Forms and agreements: what you write and sign yourself in funding, franchise and business-agreement forms (name, ID or registration number if you enter one, phone, signature).
  • Business data: for participating businesses: business name, the link to the orders sheet, and aggregated order counts used for the index.
  • Device token for notifications: a technical token from Firebase that lets us send phone notifications to your device.
  • Limited technical data: operation logs (request time, action type) to protect the platform from abuse. We do not use advertising trackers.

3. Why we use it

  • To sign you in, protect your account and show what suits your role (visitor, subscriber, member, business owner).
  • To process subscriptions, review payments and activate memberships.
  • To send notifications that concern you: subscription approval, approaching expiry, index updates, and for administrators, order alerts.
  • To calculate the index, run the platform and improve its services.

We do not sell or rent your data, and we do not use it for advertising.

4. Who processes data on our behalf

Data is stored and processed through trusted services we use to run the platform:

  • Google (sign-in, Google Sheets and Apps Script for storing records).
  • Firebase Cloud Messaging for phone notifications.
  • Cloudflare as a secure intermediary between the app and the server.
  • GitHub Pages for hosting the website pages and the app file.

We may disclose limited data if a competent legal authority requires it.

5. Storage on your device

The website and app keep your sign-in session and a copy of pages and data on your device so browsing works offline. The session is cleared when you log out, and you can clear stored data from your browser or app settings.

6. Retention

We keep subscription, payment and agreement records for the length of your membership and afterwards as needed for financial review and legal obligations. Device-token data is deleted when it becomes invalid or at your request.

7. Your rights and data deletion

You may request access to your data, correction, or deletion of your account and data. Send the request from your registered email via WhatsApp or the contact below. We will carry it out after verifying your identity, within a reasonable time, except for financial records we are legally required to keep.

To stop notifications: phone Settings → Apps → LAVNDR120 → Notifications.

8. Security

Connections use HTTPS, sign-in identity is verified through Google, and administration panels are limited to authorised accounts. Even so, no method of electronic storage or transmission is 100% secure.

9. Age

The platform is intended for adults (18 and over). We do not knowingly collect data from anyone younger.

10. Changes

We may update this policy; the date at the top shows the latest revision. Continued use after an update means you accept the new version.

Tycoon: lead a whole field or geographic sector

Last updated: 1 November 2026

What is a Tycoon?

The Tycoon is a Lavenders agency that leads a whole field or a whole geographic sector of markets and sees market movement in front of him moment by moment. There is one per field or sector.

The two types

TypeScopeValue
Field Tycoon20 markets (2,400 businesses and brands), 120 in each$51,480
Sector Tycoon400 market indices (48,000 businesses and brands) in a geographic sector$1,029,600

Prices are shown as of 1 November 2026. The current price is always on the home page when you choose a package.

How it works

The Tycoon brings businesses into unified markets through one tool and a simple system, and all of his markets move inside the Lavenders system. Rights and financial terms are set in the agency agreement, which is reviewed and signed inside the platform.

Who it is for

Anyone who wants to lead a whole field or sector. Tycoon belongs to the Economic Movement path. There is no buying, selling or trading of shares on the platform, and no promise of profits or returns. Agreement terms are shown before you subscribe.

Vindex: the Lavenders Oracle forecasting report

Last updated: 1 November 2026

What is Vindex?

Vindex (also called Lavenders Oracle) is a membership that gives you the Oracle forecasting report: an analysis of market behaviour and estimates of its movement. It is limited to 120 members.

Membership

OptionDurationPrice
Vindex1 year$1,287

Prices are shown as of 1 November 2026. The current price is always on the home page when you choose a package.

What the Oracle shows

  • Total orders and index value, the overall trend and projection.
  • A daily orders chart.
  • Top activities, products and locations by orders.
  • Monthly, half-yearly and yearly reports.
  • Short-range estimates (today, tomorrow, 7 days) with an estimated range.

Important

Estimates are approximate, not a guarantee, and become more useful as weeks of regular orders accumulate. There is no buying, selling or trading of shares on the platform, and no promise of profits or returns. Agreement terms are shown before you subscribe.

Who it is for

Anyone who wants to understand consumer behaviour and market direction early. Vindex belongs to the Join Up path.

كيفية الطلب من متجر بنيت مع لاڤندرز

تاريخ النشر: 2026-11-18 · English version

تتيح لاڤندرز للعملاء الطلب من المتاجر التي بنيت باستخدام أداة بناء التطبيقات الخاصة بها. يبدأ سير عمل العميل بالنقر على عنصر معين في المتجر، ثم يملأ نموذج الطلب، ويستلم رمزًا لمرة واحدة عبر البريد الإلكتروني، والذي يتضمن تفاصيل الحوالة البنكية. بعد ذلك، يقبل أو يرفض صاحب المتجر الطلب من على لوحة التحكم، ويتم إرسال قرار صاحب المتجر إلى العميل عبر البريد الإلكتروني. هذا السير العمل يضمن تجربة شراء سلسة وآمنة للعملاء.

سير عمل العميل

يبدأ سير عمل العميل بالنقر على عنصر معين في المتجر، ثم يملأ نموذج الطلب. بعد ذلك، يستلم رمزًا لمرة واحدة عبر البريد الإلكتروني، والذي يتضمن تفاصيل الحوالة البنكية.

أداة بناء التطبيقات

تسمح أداة بناء التطبيقات الخاصة بلاڤندرز للأعمال بإنشاء متاجر إلكترونية ومتاجر جوال، والتي يمكن الوصول إليها عبر الإنترنت أو عبر تطبيقات الجوال. هذه الأداة تتيح للأعمال إنشاء متاجرها الخاصة بسهولة وسرعة، دون الحاجة إلى مهارات تقنية متقدمة.

أهم الحقائق

  • لاڤندرز تتيح للعملاء الطلب من المتاجر التي بنيت باستخدام أداة بناء التطبيقات الخاصة بها.
  • سير عمل العميل يبدأ بالنقر على عنصر معين في المتجر، ثم يملأ نموذج الطلب.
  • صاحب المتجر يقبل أو يرفض الطلب من على لوحة التحكم، ويتم إرسال قرار صاحب المتجر إلى العميل عبر البريد الإلكتروني.
